title: 个人设备状态开关｜普通环境在佩戴后进入表演模式再归稳
source_title: 耳机触发主角模式｜街道随音乐转为MV舞台
summary: 先建立明确成年人、个人设备和普通公共环境；一次清楚佩戴或启动动作改变人物步态、环境节奏和摄影能量，但地理与身份不变，最终通过关闭或静止证明状态切换。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one personal device and an ordinary environment baseline. + Use one visible device-wear or activation action as the sole switch into the heightened state. + Change performance, camera rhythm and bounded environmental accents while preserving identity and geography. + Keep surrounding public behavior plausible so the private state remains legible by contrast. + Return camera and subject motion to a stable baseline in the same environment, with device state visibly resolved.
recommended_input: 原创清晨渡轮总站内，一名明确成年南亚通勤者穿苔绿色外套，手持小黄铜节拍器；后方人群正常行走。；接下来四步与克制琥珀地面倒影和一次前景立柱擦镜对齐；总站、脸、外套和周围行人路线不变。；她合上节拍器；光带停止，摄影机落稳，同一成年人恢复正常行走，环境不变；不加文字品牌并停住。
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one personal device and an ordinary environment baseline.
Use one visible device-wear or activation action as the sole switch into the heightened state.
Keep surrounding public behavior plausible so the private state remains legible by contrast.
Return camera and subject motion to a stable baseline in the same environment, with device state visibly resolved.
